title: Touchstone and UNICEDE
text:
Touchstone
 and 
UNICEDE

Verisk
 provides a public reference to support
 the validation of 
UNICEDE
-format exposure data in
 
Touchstone
.

UNICEDE
, is just one (open format) exposure data
 formats used by 
Verisk
 for analyzing insurance
 contracts and insurance-linked securities. 

Refer to the model documentation on the 
Client Portal
 for detailed information
 about modeled perils, construction classes, and occupancy classes, for each model.

Documentation for some 
Verisk
 models includes a
 document that serves as a guide to the secondary risk characteristics (SRCs) used in the
 model. SRCs are features of a building and its environment that have a significant impact on
 the buildingâs vulnerability to damage during an event. The SRCs are important contributing
 factors to losses sustained by residential, commercial, and industrial properties. You can
 search the 
Client Portal
 for SRC documents by typing 
secondary risk characteristics
 in the
 
 field.
